title: Message bodyType not checked vs supportedBodyTypes
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00: bodyType 'MUST be in supportedBodyTypes'; Security Considerations lists 'bodyType: validate against supportedBodyTypes' and 1e33ec7 adds that a Message/set failing such a check with no other named error MUST be rejected with invalidProperties naming the property. message.rs:501-505 reads bodyType with a default and never validates it. Error-code half overlaps JMAP-yt1w.4(e). Found by the 1e33ec7 audit (wf_af4656ea-dbb, both refuters upheld). Fix with a failing test quoting the draft; extend chat_client_wire.rs where the client exercises it.
notes: fix done in abf6969a: tests added message_set_unsupported_body_type_is_invalid_properties (chat-server integration.rs), message_unsupported_body_type_is_invalid_properties (testjig chat_client_wire.rs)
close_reason: Fixed against jmap-chat-spec 1e33ec7; test-first, reviewed, gates green (stable/beta/1.88)
